culprit.scan.busy: A scan is already running (%s s left).
culprit.scan.none: No scan yet: run /culprit scan first.
culprit.report.summary: Culprit scanned %s ticks. The server tick took %s on average and %s at worst (a tick has 50 ms).
culprit.report.more: Details: /culprit top things, types, mods or chunks.
culprit.report.incomplete: The scan met more than a million things and measured only the first million.
culprit.screen.title: Culprit
culprit.screen.empty: No scan yet. Press %s to scan the server (operators); the results show here.
culprit.kind.about.block_tick: repeaters, observers, crops on a timer
culprit.kind.about.chunk: picking blocks to tick, snow and ice
culprit.phase.about.level: weather, time, raids, the tick lists
culprit.phase.about.level_events: other mods' code run every tick
culprit.phase.about.autosave: saving the world every few minutes
culprit.part.about.rest: tick events and work between the parts
culprit.report.phases: The tick's other parts: %s; Culprit's own timing about %s; not measured %s.
culprit.chat.busy: A scan is already running (%s s left).
culprit.chat.denied: Only operators can scan this server.
culprit.chat.done: Done. The server tick took %s on average and %s at worst (it has 50 ms).
culprit.scan.title: Culprit: scan the server
culprit.scan.about: Times everything the server does while it runs, then shows where the tick went. Nothing in your world is changed.
culprit.scan.no_server: This server does not have Culprit: its ticks cannot be scanned.
culprit.scan.denied: Only operators can scan this server.
culprit.screen.summary2: The server tick took %s on average and %s at worst over %s ticks (a tick has 50 ms). Below, all of it: what each part took.
culprit.screen.game_work.about: chunks, levels, connections: each in the Tick tab
culprit.screen.view.about: Average: every tick of the scan. Lag spikes: only the ticks that took over twice the usual tick (and at least 5 ms), to find what makes them slow.
culprit.screen.no_spikes: No lag spikes in this scan: no tick took over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 5 ms). The slowest took %s.
culprit.screen.spikes_summary: %s lag spikes: ticks over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 5 ms). In them the tick took %s on average and %s at worst. Below, what each part took in them.
culprit.report.spikes: Lag spikes: %s ticks over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 5 ms), %s on average; the costliest in them: %s.
culprit.report.no_spikes: No lag spikes: no tick took over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 5 ms).
culprit.scan.about2: Times what the server does, or what this game draws, then shows where the time went. Nothing in your world is changed.
culprit.scan.ticks: Server ticks: what lags the server
culprit.scan.frames: Frames: what lowers your frame rate
culprit.scan.frames_ready: Pick how long; play as usual while it scans.
culprit.chat.frames_busy: A frame scan is already running.
culprit.chat.frames_done: Done. A frame took %s on average (%s FPS) and %s at worst.
culprit.screen.view.about_frames: Average: every frame of the scan. Stutters: only the frames that took over twice the usual frame (and at least 20 ms), to find what makes them slow.
culprit.screen.empty_frames: No frame scan yet. Press %s and pick a length under Frames: what each thing in view costs your frame rate shows here.
culprit.screen.frames_summary: A frame took %s on average (%s FPS) and %s at worst over %s frames. Below, all of it: what each part took.
culprit.screen.no_stutters: No stutters in this scan: no frame took over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 20 ms). The slowest took %s.
culprit.screen.stutters_summary: %s stutters: frames over %s (twice the usual %s, and at least 20 ms). In them a frame took %s on average and %s at worst. Below, what each part took in them.
culprit.screen.game_work.about_frames: the world, the HUD, waiting: each in the Frame tab
culprit.frame.about.client_tick: mobs and sounds moving between frames
culprit.frame.about.packets: the server's packets and queued tasks
culprit.frame.about.extract: the world's blocks, sky and weather in view
culprit.frame.about.particles: all of them handed in, and the rarer kinds made ready
culprit.frame.about.submit: the world's other parts, handed in
culprit.frame.about.batching: the handed-in parts put in order (the things' shares are with them)
culprit.frame.about.drawing: terrain, sky and clouds sent to the GPU
culprit.frame.about.mod_events: other mods' code run every frame
culprit.frame.about.present: waiting for the GPU or the screen, and the frame's upkeep
culprit.frame.about.limit: waiting, as the frame-rate limit asks
culprit.kind.about.particle: smoke, flames, dust: moved and made ready
culprit.frame.about.particle_kinds: each kind, moved and made ready
culprit.frame.about.entities2: made ready, handed in, their share of the drawing
culprit.frame.about.block_entities2: chests, signs: made ready, handed in, drawn
culprit.frame.about.features: the sorted parts sent to the GPU (the things' shares are with them)
culprit.frame.about.far_terrain: its far terrain drawn, and faded into the game's
culprit.frame.about.shadows: Iris drawing the world again from the sun for the shader pack (the things' shadows are with them)
culprit.chunks.summary: %s: %s chunks loaded (%s ticking entities, %s ticking blocks, %s at the border; %s more at the edges). Kept loaded by: %s.
culprit.screen.chunks_no_server: This server does not have Culprit: its loaded chunks cannot be looked at.
culprit.screen.chunks_denied: Only operators can look at this server's loaded chunks.
culprit.chunks.empty: Press Look now to see every loaded chunk of this dimension, how busy it is, and what keeps it loaded.
culprit.chunks.headline: %s chunks loaded here: %s ticking entities, %s ticking blocks, %s at the border (and %s more at the edges). Kept loaded by %s.
culprit.chunks.status.border: at the border: loaded, not ticking
culprit.chunks.tooltip:
Chunk %s, %s: %s
Kept loaded by %s%s%s

culprit.configuration.world.tooltip: How the results show on the world, once shown from the results screen.
culprit.configuration.range.tooltip: How far from you things are boxed, in blocks.
culprit.configuration.labels.tooltip: How many of the costliest things near you are labelled with their cost (0: none; the one you look at is always read out under the crosshair).
culprit.configuration.hideAfterMinutes.t: Minutes after which the results hide from the world by themselves (0: they stay until you hide them).
culprit.configuration.hud.tooltip: The server's ticks and your frames, always on screen.
culprit.configuration.hudLine.tooltip: The server's ticks a second and time a tick (on a server, when you may scan there) and your frames a second and time a frame, in a line on screen. A key in Controls turns it on and off (none set at first).
culprit.configuration.hudCorner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the HUD line sits in.
culprit.configuration.permissions.toolti: Who may use Culprit's scans on this server.
culprit.configuration.scanLevel.tooltip: Permission level needed to scan the server, look at its loaded chunks and get the HUD line's server numbers: 0 everyone, 1 moderators, 2 operators (the default), 3 admins, 4 the owner. Teleporting to a result uses the game's own /tp permission.
culprit.configuration.maxSeconds.tooltip: The longest tick scan anyone may start, in seconds.
culprit.screen.save.about: Saves this scan as a page to read (Markdown) and as JSON, in the game folder's culprit/reports, to share.
culprit.chat.saved: Saved the report: %s (and the same as .json).
culprit.export.saved: Saved the report: %s (and the same as .json).
